summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its schedule of investor and industry conferences for September 2026. The release details upcoming engagements at the H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference and the Precious Metals Summit Beaver Creek, where management will discuss the Ontario cobalt sulfate refinery and North American critical minerals strategy. No corporate transaction, board action, or special situation is disclosed; this is routine investor relations activity. The Form 6-K incorporates the press release into existing registration statements. What to watch: no deal terms or risk-arb angle; purely administrative.
